title: Gate relations for evaluated assignments
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Form a sign assignment to all input and gate coordinates by encoding each input bit and each gate's evaluated value as a sign, with false encoded by $1$ and true by $-1$. At every gate, the Boolean value encoded at its coordinate agrees with the operation specified by that gate, applied to the encoded values of its input bit or earlier gates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit on n input bits
